newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange edges up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange edges up in light trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange's main index rose slightly on Wednesday in modest trade, its market report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index edged up by 0.27 points to 360.19 points after rising 0.65 points in its previous session on Monday.
Volume was down at 125,210 shares traded, down from Monday's 710,560. Offers totalled 1,615,410 and bids 1,207,550.
Kumasi Brewery Limited (+20 cedis to 680 cedis), Social Security Bank (+8 to 1,068 cedis) and Mechanical Lloyd Company (+2 to 55 cedis) were the only stocks to rise.
Mobil Oil Ghana Limited (-85 to 5,500 cedis) was the only issue to post a decline.
